overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new in-memory-only menu (blank, or an exact copy of the menu identified by menu including its submenus) and returns its MenuRef.

constraints: A new MenuRef is created even when copying an existing menu; the copy is independent of the source menu after creation.
A menu created without the menu parameter is blank and must be populated/managed via RELEASE MENU, SET MENU ITEM, and related commands.
